title: Fail closed on ambiguous Staging environment authority syntax

phases.objective: Prevent Docker Compose and exact PowerShell readers from resolving different Staging authorities when .env.staging contains whitespace, export-prefixed, or duplicate normalized keys. The smart One-Click wrapper validates canonical KEY=VALUE syntax before invoking the dual-mode core and emits only non-secret evidence.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Ambiguous .env.staging key syntax is rejected before the dual-mode core can start, preventing a raw host key from diverging from the Docker Compose/container authority and eliminating misleading authenticated readiness 403 failures.
steps: Resolve the ignored local .env.staging file without printing values.
Ignore blank and comment lines and require every other line to be a canonical KEY=VALUE assignment.
Normalize assignment names only for validation and reject whitespace or export-prefixed aliases whose raw name differs from the canonical name.
Reject duplicate keys after normalization before invoking the One-Click core.
Emit bounded non-secret pass evidence when the file is canonical.
assertions: BACKEND_API_KEY =value is rejected rather than being allowed to compete with BACKEND_API_KEY=value.
Duplicate normalized authorities fail closed before Docker Compose or remote authenticated readiness runs.
No environment value or secret is written to logs or structured evidence.
The guard remains compatible with Windows PowerShell 5.1.
No Production deployment, Production access, Cloudflare DNS mutation, database mutation, migration apply, ruleset mutation, secret rotation, container deletion, or volume deletion is authorized.
